idea: Sign in with Google and carry every learner's progress, daily and weekly work across devices — instantly, offline-capable, with every sync visible on the page

text: the site is static on GitHub Pages: 103 pages generated by tools/build.py, zero network calls anywhere in the 4700-line app.js, and every piece of learner state in eleven localStorage keys under en8:. There is no service worker and no manifest. So 'learn everywhere' and 'instant' are both greenfield, and neither can be done by the page alone

Firebase Spark was chosen over Supabase for a reason that is not about features: Supabase pauses a free project after 7 days of inactivity, and this learner studies in bursts around a Saturday session. A paused project is a dark app until a human resumes it. Spark cannot bill at all — it has no payment method, so an exceeded quota returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and resets at midnight Pacific rather than charging

Cloud Storage for Firebase has required the paid Blaze plan since 2026-02-03. It is the single trapdoor from free to billed, and it is why art and audio stay in the static build. That is also the better architecture independently: GitHub Pages is already a CDN, and the immutable/mutable split (art in the build, per-user progress in Firestore) is what any offline-capable app wants

the twelve 'recordings' are browser speechSynthesis, not audio files — zero bytes shipped. Shipped assets today total ~1.06MB against GitHub Pages' 1GB limit, so there is no size pressure that would justify moving assets to a backend

app.js states a rule over the reading log in its own words: it must never become a score, a band, a reading rate, a words-per-minute, a streak or a comparison with anyone. A dated daily/weekly work record is exactly where a streak counter would appear, so the rhythm gate scans the rendered page for one

no Java runtime existed on this machine; the Firestore emulator is a Java program (the Auth emulator is not). OpenJDK 26 was installed with the operator's approval. The harness resolves the keg-only path itself rather than editing a shell profile, so a fresh variant worktree needs no hand configuration
